events.title: Events
events.signupCount: {count, plural, =0 {No signups} one {# signup} other {# signups}}
events.waitlistExplanation: All squad and backup slots are currently full. We'll let you know if a spot opens up. You can still update your preferences below.
events.waitlistFullNotice: All squad and backup slots are full. New signups will be added to the waitlist.
events.signupsClosed: Signups are currently closed for this event.

eventCard.deletedNotice: This event was deleted on {date}. Signup data is retained for attendance reports.

signupForm.squadPreferenceHelp: Pick the squad you most want to play on. If your first choice is full, admins will try to place you on your second choice ({secondName}).
signupForm.willingBackupLabel: Willing to be a backup player if main roster is full
signupForm.willingBackupHelp: Backups fill in if a main-roster player drops. Uncheck if you only want to play if you get a starting slot.
signupForm.leadershipLabel: Request a leadership position ({slots} per squad)
signupForm.leadershipHelp: Leaders coordinate their squad during the match. Admins choose who gets the role from the requests.
signupForm.leadershipNotePlaceholder: Why would you like a leadership role? (optional)
signupForm.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

createEventForm.name: Event Name *
createEventForm.nameHelp: Shown to players in the event list and roster.
createEventForm.startTimeHelp: When the event starts. Used for the calendar download.
createEventForm.descriptionHelp: Optional. Plain text shown on the event page.
createEventForm.signupOpensHelp: When players can start signing up. Leave blank to open immediately.
createEventForm.signupClosesHelp: When the signup form locks. Existing signups can still be edited by admins. Leave blank for no deadline.
createEventForm.squad1NameHelp: Display name for the first squad.
createEventForm.squad2NameHelp: Display name for the second squad.
createEventForm.squadStartsAtHelp: When this squad plays. Optional — can be set later.
createEventForm.maxPlayersHelp: Main roster size per squad. Includes leaders.
createEventForm.maxBackupsHelp: Backup slots per squad. Once main + backup are full, new signups go to the waitlist.
createEventForm.leadershipSlotsHelp: How many leader spots each squad has. Players request a leader role; admins assign it.

editEventDates.gameTimeHelp: When the event starts. Used for the calendar download.
editEventDates.signupOpensHelp: When players can start signing up. Leave blank to open immediately.
editEventDates.signupClosesHelp: When the signup form locks. Leave blank for no deadline.
editEventDates.squadStartsAtHelp: When this squad plays. Leave blank if not scheduled yet.

admin.deletedKept: Kept for attendance reports. Click to view.
admin.noUpcoming: No upcoming events. Click '+ New event' to create one.
admin.confirmDelete: Delete event "{name}"? This is reversible — it'll be hidden from players but signup data is kept for attendance reports.
admin.movedTooltip: Player's first choice was {squadName}, but an admin moved them.
admin.moveBackupTooltip: Move this player to the backup roster.
admin.moveRosterTooltip: Move this player back onto the main roster.
admin.roleDropdownTooltip: Assign this player a role. Unassigned = on the roster but not yet placed. Waitlist = no slot available.
admin.attendedTooltip: Mark whether this player showed up for the match.
admin.ratingTooltip: Optional 1-5 rating used for future roster decisions. Click again on a star to change.
admin.leaderBadgeTooltip: This player asked to be considered for a leader role.
admin.waitlistOrdered: Ordered by signup time. Promote a player by changing their Assigned Role from "waitlist" to player, backup, or leader.

playersPage.backupOkTooltip: Player accepted being a backup if the main roster fills up.
playersPage.leadershipTooltip: Player asked to be considered for a leader spot.

playersPage.attendedTooltip: Admin marked this player as showing up for the match.
playersPage.noShowTooltip: Admin marked this player as a no-show.

membersPage.title: Members
membersPage.summary: {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} · {admins, plural, one {# admin} other {# admins}}
membersPage.promoteTooltip: Promote this member to guild admin. Admins can create events, manage signups, invite members, and edit guild settings.
membersPage.demoteTooltip: Demote this admin back to a regular member.
membersPage.demoteLastAdminTooltip: Can't demote the last admin — promote someone else first.
membersPage.kickTooltip: Remove this member from the guild. Their past signups are soft-deleted (kept for attendance history).
membersPage.kickLastAdminTooltip: Can't kick the last admin — promote someone else first.
membersPage.kickConfirm: Remove this member from the guild?

invitesPage.title: Invites
invitesPage.summary: Generate links to invite people to your guild. Anyone with the link joins immediately.
invitesPage.expiresAtHelp: Link stops working after this time. Blank = never expires.
invitesPage.maxUsesHelp: Number of joins allowed. Blank = unlimited.

guildSettingsPage.title: Guild Settings
guildSettingsPage.name: Name
guildSettingsPage.nameHelp: Display name shown in the sidebar and discovery list.
guildSettingsPage.descriptionHelp: Optional. Shown on the public guild page to help recruiting.
guildSettingsPage.isPublicHelp: When on, signed-in users can find this guild on /guilds and join with one click. When off, you can only invite members via invite link.
guildSettingsPage.serverNumberHelp: Game-server number (1001-9999). Optional. Shown for ops reference.
guildSettingsPage.guildTagHelp: 2-4 characters. When set, prepended to every member's displayed name as [TAG] name.
guildSettingsPage.discordChannelIdHelp: Optional. The bot will post @everyone reminders here 1 day, 1 hour, and 20 minutes before each event. Leave blank to disable. Add the bot to your server first, then right-click the channel in Discord → Copy Channel ID (Developer Mode required). Test sends a one-off message to the channel — no @everyone ping.
guildSettingsPage.testSuccess: ✅ Test message sent. Check the channel.
guildSettingsPage.leaveExplanation: Leaving this guild removes you and soft-deletes your past signups. If you're the only admin, promote someone else first.
guildSettingsPage.leaveConfirm: Leave this guild? Your past signups will be hidden from your view (kept for guild attendance reports).

guilds.title: Guilds
guilds.subtitleInGuild: You're already a member of a guild. To join another, leave your current one first.
guilds.subtitleNotInGuild: Join an existing guild, create your own, or use an invite link.
guilds.noPublicGuilds: No public guilds yet. Be the first to create one.
guilds.alreadyInGuild: You're already in another guild. Leave it first to join this one.
guilds.newGuildSubtitle: You'll be the first admin. You can invite others once it's created.
guilds.nameHelp: Display name shown in the sidebar and discovery list.
guilds.slugHelp: URL-safe ID. 3-40 chars: a-z, 0-9, hyphens. Permanent — can't be changed after creation.
guilds.descriptionHelp: Optional. Shown on the public guild page.
guilds.isPublicHelp: When on, anyone signed in can find your guild on /guilds and join. When off, only people with an invite link can join.

joinByCode.inviteInvalidExplain: This invite link has expired, been revoked, or is invalid. Ask your guild admin for a new one.
joinByCode.alreadyInGuildExplain: You're a member of another guild. Leave it first, then come back to this link to join {guildName}.

myAccount.title: My Account
myAccount.subtitle: Update your in-game name, leave your guild, or delete your account.
myAccount.inGameNameHelp: This is how you appear on rosters and signups. Up to {max} characters.
myAccount.leaveExplanation: Leaving this guild removes you from its events and soft-deletes your past signups (kept for the guild's attendance reports).
myAccount.leaveAdminWarning: Because you're an admin, you can only leave if there's another admin remaining.
myAccount.deleteExplanation: Deleting your account permanently removes your user record, all your signups, and unlinks any Google/Discord accounts. You won't be able to recover this — sign in again would create a new, empty account.
myAccount.deleteConfirm: Delete your account? This removes you from your guild, deletes all your signups, and unlinks Google/Discord. This can't be undone.

errors.lastAdminKick: Cannot kick the last admin. Promote someone else first.
errors.lastAdminLeave: You're the only admin. Promote another member to admin before leaving.
errors.lastAdminDelete: You're the only admin of your guild. Promote someone else first, or have a super-admin take over.
errors.lastSuperAdminDelete: You're the last super-admin. Promote someone else to super-admin before deleting your account.
